question: Who became Indian Air Force’s first woman fighter pilot from Jammu and Kashmir in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mawya Sudan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In 2021, Mawya Sudan, from Rajoiru district, Jammu and Kashmir, became the first women fighter pilot in the Indian Air Force (IAF). Hence option 4 is correct.**

 
 
• ​She is the 12th women officer of fighter pilots in the IAF.
 
 
 
• **She is now commissioned into the Indian Air Force (IAF) fighter stream at the Air Force Academy at Dundigal, Hyderabad.**
 
• **Avani Chaturvedi, Mohana Singh and Bhawana Kanth became the first female fighter pilots in the Indian Air Force (IAF).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Punita Arora is to be the first lady Lieutenant General of the Indian Army** and is a Surgeon Vice Admiral in the Army.

 
 
• **She is the first woman in the Indian Armed Forces to be promoted to a Three-star rank.**
 
• She also served as a Lieutenant General and Vice Admiral in the Army.
 
 
 
• **Mitali Madhumita** is serving as a colonel in the Indian Army and is the first woman officer to receive a gallantry award.
 
 
• **In 2011, she received Sena Medal for the courage shown during the attack on the Indian Embassy in Afghanistan.**
 
 
 
• **Padmavathy Bandopadhyay** from Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, is a former Air Marshal and a Flight Lieutenant in the Indian Air Force.
 
 
• ​**She was the first woman to be promoted as Air Marshal in the IAF and the second woman to be promoted to a three-star rank after Punita Arora.**
